# WebSocket replay fixtures

`synthetic_prerecorded_frame.json` is a generated, prerecorded image payload
used to exercise the FastAPI/WebSocket binary-frame path. It deliberately
contains no person, identity, or biometric data.

Do not add real face images or videos to this public repository without written
redistribution consent, a retention decision, a licence review, and a documented
attack/genuine label. Production PAD evaluation fixtures should live in a
restricted dataset store with their consent and provenance records.
